generated_entry_conditions: Quote both sides only when book_spread > 2.0x rv_60m; refresh quotes every 30 seconds and skew against current inventory
hypothesis_name: Slow Inventory-Aware Quoting Module (from: Adverse Selection Avoidance in Passive Crypto Execution (Wor)
one_sentence_idea: Spread capture with inventory-risk-based quote skew is viable at seconds-to-minutes cadence when spreads are wide relative to volatility.
core_alpha_hypothesis: Spread capture with inventory-risk-based quote skew is viable at seconds-to-minutes cadence when spreads are wide relative to volatility.
entry_rules: Quote both sides only when book_spread > 2.0x rv_60m; refresh quotes every 30 seconds and skew against current inventory
exit_rules: Withdraw quotes and unwind passively when inventory > 5% of capital (hard stop)
Exit on regime transition: withdraw quotes when rv_60m regime turns high-volatility
risk_rules: max position risk 1% of equity per trade (default)
position_sizing: risk 1% of equity per trade using stop distance 1.5x ATR_60m
fees_slippage_model: taker 7 bps per side (fees + slippage); maker 1 bp where passive fills are realistic
order_assumptions: market (taker) orders at next 1m bar open after signal; no partial fills modeled; execution latency tolerance >= 1 bar (non-HFT by construction)
baseline_comparisons: randomized-entry baseline with identical exits and sizing
unconditional variant (same rules without the regime/filter condition)
expected_failure_modes: edge is an artifact of survivorship or lookahead bias
signal decays after fees at the target timeframe
regime dependence: works only in trending/high-vol samples
minimum_viable_backtest: Primary: BTC, ETH perpetuals, 1m-15m bars (order_book_snapshots), over >=3 years including one bear market. Compare vs the baseline set (buy-and-hold, randomized-entry, unconditional variant).
walk_forward_validation_plan: Rolling walk-forward: 12-month train / 3-month test, stepped quarterly; require positive OOS expectancy in >=60% of folds.
anti_overfitting_checks: parameter-stability heatmap (edge must not live in one cell)
deflated Sharpe ratio on OOS results
test on assets not used for parameter selection
